adaptive_rules.coach_note: Model Y: treat orange HV as off-limits. 12V location and type vary by year — use the manual. Precondition before DC fast charging in cold weather.
Tesla tip: scheduled departure + preconditioning protects range and charge speed. Service Mode / HV work is shop-only.
BEV: daily charge habits matter more than 'full every time.' Keep the traction pack away from 0% and long 100% soaks when you can.
Hybrid/PHEV: the 12V still runs computers and contactors. A 'dead' hybrid is often a weak 12V — HV orange cables stay untouched.
Higher-mile EV: watch for rising 12V issues and charge-port wear. Traction pack health belongs in a qualified EV shop.
Cold climate: precondition cabin and battery while plugged in when possible — saves range and speeds DC charging.
